operation_details.item: The user uses precedent transactions in valuation work.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning. I'm reviewing the Q2 valuation package for the acquisition model. Can you clarify your methodology so I can align the supporting schedules?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use discounted cash flow for primary valuation.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. And how do you sanity-check the DCF output before it goes into the board deck?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use comparable company multiples as a cross-check.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. That cross-check should help support the assumptions. Where do you keep the supporting documentation?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I document all valuation assumptions in the memo.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. I'll make sure the memo includes the key drivers. One more thing—when you need to triangulate value for a merger scenario, do you ever use transaction data?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use precedent transactions in my valuation work.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Perfect. Then I'll structure the analysis around your DCF with comps cross-check and precedent transactions, and reference the memo for all assumptions. Does that match your workflow?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, that's exactly how I want it laid out. Just keep the memo concise.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I'll prepare the draft by end of day and flag any data gaps.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks. I'll review it once you're done.
